items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Claude Thornhill in relation to Joe Shulman, but the interviewee (Jo Jones) does not mention Claude Thornhill or indicate any personal interaction with him.

ctx.x: Yes, Buddy DeFranco and the bass player that played with tape on his hand - Jimmy Lewis, and Freddie Green. Freddie Green was playing with Lester Young at the Birdland, and Joe Shulman -
Joe Shulman, a very good bass player. He used to play with Claude Thornhill. A dear friend of mine, a magnificent bass player.

Joe Shulman took his whole salary and gave it to Freddie Green. Basie came down, and Morris Levy will tell you, Morris Levy was paying at an unheard salary of $125 a week. The scale was $87. The man from the union - they had moved the union on 52nd Street - and the man came in and told Morris Levy that he was paying too much money. Morris Levy says, "I'm not paying enough.
